thread:
maria: Quick note - ran initial QC for 'cottontail-compact' using int6 and fp16 on the short-holdout (1k queries) + 200k DB.

maria: Baseline sentinel-v2 fp16 included for reference.

maria: Command used:
```
python tools/run_embed_eval.py --model cottontail-compact --quant int6 --db-size 200000 --holdout short_v2 --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_mean,silhouette
```

eval-bot: Run summary (1k q / 200k db):
- sentinel-v2 fp16: recall@1=0.548, recall@5=0.814, recall@10=0.886, cosine_mean_pos=0.65, silhouette=0.42
- cottontail fp16: recall@1=0.540, recall@5=0.806, recall@10=0.879, cosine_mean_pos=0.64, silhouette=0.41
- cottontail int6 (per-tensor): recall@1=0.514, recall@5=0.772, recall@10=0.846, cosine_mean_pos=0.58, silhouette=0.35

maria: Observed compression in norms and drop in cosine similarity for positives with per-tensor int6.

zane: Is this the newer quant pipeline or old one? Any asymmetric rounding on the scale factor?

maria: Old pipeline. No bias correction enabled. I didn't toggle per-channel.

priya: Quick stats on L2 norms (sample 200k):
- sentinel-v2 fp16 mean=1.05 std=0.10
- cottontail fp16 mean=1.01 std=0.09
- cottontail int6 mean=0.88 std=0.08
Distribution shifted and tightened.

zane: Try per-channel quant + symmetric scaling and run only 50k DB to speed iteration. Compare cosine_mean_pos and recall@5.

maria: Kicking per-channel + symmetric scale run now on a dogfood GPU. Also adding a tiny long-tail subset (200 queries len>120).

ops: Allocating r-dogfood-09 for 60m, tag "cot-qc-477".

eval-bot: queued small-run 477-qc-01 (per-channel symmetric int6, 50k DB). ETA ~12m.

eval-bot: 477-qc-01 complete: cottontail int6 (per-channel symmetric) recall@5=0.802, recall@1=0.526, recall@10=0.864, cosine_mean_pos=0.63, silhouette=0.40

priya: Per-channel brought cosine_mean_pos back close to fp16 and silhouette improved. recall@5 gap vs sentinel ~1.2%.

zane: Throughput numbers?

maria: Throughput measured on r-dogfood-09: int6 per-channel ~2.05x vs cottontail fp16 baseline. Latency p95 increased slightly vs per-tensor but still within target.

priya: Long-tail subset (200 q) results with per-channel int6: recall@5 drop larger (~1.8%) vs sentinel on long queries. Might need length-aware renorm or fallback routing for >120 tokens.

maria: Good catch. Proposal: canary with 5% traffic but add length-based routing (queries >100 tokens -> fp16) and daily holdout eval for 7 days.

zane: Also add cosine calibration step (compute per-batch bias and shift) to preprocessing pipeline; could reduce long-tail degradation. Worth testing before canary.

maria: I'll run quick calibration + per-channel int6 tomorrow and post results. If calibration closes long-tail gap <1%, we go to canary.

ops: Noted. Runner will hold for calibration run.

maria: Action items I will do: 1) PR with per-channel int6 config + symmetric scaling, 2) add length-aware route config, 3) schedule daily eval-run hook for first week of canary.

priya: Also add regression alert: recall@5 drop >1.5% on short holdout OR >2.0% on long-tail triggers rollback.

maria: Thanks — will update the onboarding doc link once PR is ready.
